14:1332.en: 「All of $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ is yours!」

14:1406.en: 「$$ダンクーガ$$, you are humanity's hope.」

15:5411.en: 「We bet our lives on her last words!」

17:5895.en: 「Here we go! $$ファイヤバグ$$'s last fight!」

17:5936.en: 「Princess's last order! I'll do it or die!」

19:2395.en: 「Your brain looks full of holes too!」

19:2533.en: 「You have a reason to attack people...?」

19:2603.en: 「Just like I used to be...\nlooking away from the hole...!」

19:2799.en: 「The hole you made in Earth,\nwe'll fill it!」

19:2891.en: 「You won't get it!\nThe future belongs to each of us!」

19:2952.en: 「The hole you made in the galaxy,\nwe'll fill it!」

19:6068.en: 「Even a lost heart's hole is filling...!」

31:3691.en: 「Blue and Green! I'll protect both Earths!」

31:3767.en: 「Defeating the $$サイデリアル$$ is our mission!」

31:3808.en: 「Are you truly fit to wield a $$スフィア$$?」

31:3847.en: 「I regret that it has come to this.」

31:3915.en: 「I will strike the opening $$ランド$$ made.」

31:3948.en: 「Let me lend you a hand, $$クロウ$$.」

31:3977.en: 「I won't let you grieve any more.」

31:4012.en: 「You hardly need my help, I suppose.」

31:4051.en: 「Needless damage only\nadds to your debt, no?」

37:491.en: 「It's too late to stop it now!」

37:639.en: 「From here, the world will be reborn!」

37:1592.en: 「So that's the successor to that one!」

37:7032.en: 「And the world was\nonly about to change...!」

37:5586.en: 「Impossible...!\nIt's beyond anything an AS can do!」

44:0.en: 「Don't get cocky, $$ガロード・ラン$$. Think all goes your way? Dead wrong.」

50:3350.en: 「I'll dig right through!\nTo this universe's future!」

50:7454.en: 「My heart'll fill the hole in yours!」

64:892.en: 「You stayed a woman to the end, $$レコア$$...!」

64:1591.en: 「If I can smash them all here at once...!」

g004.basis: Single wordless 「………………」 line; no speech to identify anyone (Jigoku had none either)

g014.basis: Block holds two Dragon's Hive voices: formal F.S. (14:134-3062, our weapon-slot-2 rows: commands Dancouga, 'I entrust all of Dragon's Hive to you') and polite Tanaka (14:3099+, ハイ/WILL-san). Our rows are F.S.; Jigoku's token 田中司令 fits only the second half

g015.basis: Generic Firebug mercenary in an Axio Burglar; addresses Beck, Gates, Kan Yu by name so is none of them; 姫 = the late Princess (Marilyn). Same as Jigoku (no pilot)

g017.basis: Generic wisecracking Firebug mercenary (Bonta-kun, Tessa-tan, 'Beck no aniki', 'Gates senpai' lines); 姫 = the late Princess. Same as Jigoku (no pilot)

g019.basis: Hole (穴) motif, 'MIX, moving out', called 穴埋め女; female polite-sharp register. Agrees with Jigoku

g031.basis: Asclepus attacks, Chrono/captain lines, supports Hibiki/Setsuko/Rand/Crowe (Crowe's debt joke). Agrees with Jigoku

g037.basis: Generic Amalgam AS mercenary (story speaker $$アマルガム$$): follows/covers Mr. Ag, Lambda Driver lines, 'world transformation' goal, generic taunts of every series. NOT Gauron as Jigoku guessed

g044.basis: Exact suspend-message exchange with Garrod in dlg_2700_06 (861:t_078:4/7/9) is spoken by $$アルベルト$$. Jigoku had no identification

g050.basis: Rough male voice, digging/hole lines, 'Aquarion to Aquarion'; the set is Andy's Gepard bank (Andy/MIX/Yunoha). Agrees with Jigoku ($$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$)

g064.basis: Mourns Reccoa ('レコアさん'), Mk-II lines elsewhere in the set. Agrees with Jigoku ($$エマ・シーン$$)

uncertain: 14: block 14 mixes F.S. (formal, first half) and Tanaka (polite, second half); our weapon-slot-2 rows sit in the F.S. part and read as F.S. handing Dragon's Hive's energy to Dancouga. Speaker token set to F.S., not Jigoku's Commander Tanaka.
14:1185 全員覚悟は出来ているな = 'Is everyone ready for this?' (覚悟 softened to 'ready').
15/17: 姫 = the late Firebug Princess (Marilyn per the story); rendered 'the Princess'/'her' as the set's reused lines do. 15:5411 uses 'her last words' (no 'Princess') for length.
17:5854 最後の任務 rendered 'our last job' (merc slang, length) while g015 uses 'last mission'; subject 'I' restored (果たしますぜ).
19:2603 穴から目を背けている: kept the hole motif literally ('looking away from the hole'); subject of the second half (the enemy) is implied by 'Just like I used to be'.

19:3362/3453 神話型 = 'Legendary type'/'Legendary name' (as in an earlier voice brief), not the full $$神話型アクエリオン$$ token. 3453 (cover) is ambiguous: could be scolding the covered ally or the attacker; kept addressee-neutral.
19:6068 失われた心の穴 (special cut-in): read as 'a lost heart's hole is filling'; whose heart is not settled by the line.
31:3977 これ以上、君を悲しませはしない (cover): 'I won't let you grieve any more' - target probably Setsuko but not stated.
31:4012 cover line for an unnamed strong ally: 'You hardly need my help, I suppose.'

37: speaker is a generic Amalgam AS pilot (story grunt speaker is $$アマルガム$$), not Gauron. 変容 = 'transformation' as Leonard's 'transformation of the world' in the story; ミスタ・Ａｇ = plain 'Mr. Ag' as in the story.
37:1592 例の奴の後継機 = 'the successor to that one' (the Arbalest is implied, not named).
37:5586 奴 = 'It' (the machine) to avoid assuming the pilot's gender.

44: speaker is Alberto (exact suspend exchange in dlg_2700_06, 861:t_078). 44:0 left at 65 chars on one line: suspend message, no break in the Japanese; compressed to 'Think all goes your way? Dead wrong.'
50:4212 元祖 = 'the original' (support attack, presumably for the original/Legendary Aquarion).
64:725 縁談アリ (special cut-in, apparently a fortune reading): 'Marriage offer soon,' huh?'
64:892 Reccoa has no glossary token; used $$レコア$$ (see names).

レコア.evidence: 64:892 Emma's レコアさん; official Z Gundam name Reccoa Londe; English 'Reccoa' already appears in a translated DSCR (Emma's profile)
